recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-44476 unless the work group later wants broader canonical-resource guidance outside the ActorDefinition page.
issue_request: FHIR-44476 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking what relationship an ActorDefinition has to an ImplementationGuide. The approved resolution was to clarify that ActorDefinitions can be defined, published, and managed in ImplementationGuides, used to describe expected capabilities and roles within an IG, and reused by dependent implementation guides.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by c52fbecea0e02592c3de1db0ca1c492d3962714b ("Fix FHIR-44476") on 2025-02-18, after the Jira comment linked PR #3307. That commit added the approved paragraph to source/actordefinition/actordefinition-introduction.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists actordefinition=ActorDefinition and assigns actordefinition to the FHIR work group, confirming current build scope. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-02-05 record FHIR-44476 as Persuasive with a 10-0-0 vote. Later same-file commits for FHIR-44472 and FHIR-44761 changed neighboring prose and a link typo but did not alter the ActorDefinition/IG paragraph. Zulip had no direct FHIR-44476 messages and Confluence refs found the recorded minutes.
